headline: Wednesday, November 18 — the storm itself: heavy rain all day, leave early for Kaiser at 9.

items: Adult IOP group session today 9:00 AM-12:00 PM at Delta Fair Medical Offices, Antioch.
The storm peaks midday: 8 AM is 87% rain with 32 mph gusts, 11 AM to 2 PM near 100%. Leave by 8:15.
It eases by evening: 5 PM down to 55%, 8 PM around 30%. Day 2 of recovery - meds on schedule first.

sections.lead: Heavy rain all day, 49/49, southeast winds gusting 35 mph. ABC7 upgraded it to a Level 3 storm.
items: Wed 11/18: 49/49, heavy rain all day, gusts 35 mph. Heaviest 11 AM-2 PM.
Thu 11/19: 50/44, showers tapering, 75%.
Fri 11/20: 55/40, sunny, light north wind. The clear day.
Sun 11/22: 53/42, mostly cloudy, light rain at night.
Mon 11/23: 53/42, light rain chances return, 45%.

sections.lead: Quiet focus, careful words, soft company.
items: Mercury squares your Sun almost dead-on today, so double-check any appointment details or texts you send.
Saturn still steadies your Sun: follow-through and discipline are the strong tools.
Venus sits right on your Moon for a third day: lean into the people who feel good, and the IOP room fits that.
Moon moves into Pisces, 61% waxing: a dreamier, lower-energy day. Rest is the point, not a failure.
Summary: do the quiet work, reread before sending, accept the softness. Use it: keep the IOP session, skip anything demanding wordsmithing.
Zero new construction-dispatch postings. Same three on LinkedIn: Vulcan asphalt dispatcher (Napa), Cemex (French Camp), Gill's Electric (Oakland).
ZipRecruiter hit a security wall and Indeed login-walled again; the full 27-result Bay Area read from Monday still stands.
Tracker holds at 49.
GM passed on the AV Operations Coordinator application (arrived ~9:13 PM Tuesday). Talent community note is boilerplate.
No other application mail.
No interview requests. Two Workday notes checked: GM rejection above, Symbotic already logged Tuesday.
Storm went Level 3: waterspouts were spotted near Candlestick Point, and a High Wind Warning covers the East Bay hills to 70 mph gusts around Altamont Pass (ABC7).
Antioch police arrested a 19-year-old in Tuesday night's fatal shooting of a 54-year-old man near D and West 19th (KRON4).
Weekend ICE arrests across the Tri-Cities area are rattling East Bay residents (East Bay Times).
The Zeka Group Blue Oaks Ridge plan (724 homes near Black Diamond Mines) continues to draw pushback (SF Chronicle).
Nothing new on the planner notes.
Easy win: iron day - take it after the session.
8:05 AM: my EDD redial fires to try filing the SDI claim by phone (attempt 3).
9:00 AM-12:00 PM: Kaiser IOP at Delta Fair. Leave by 8:15.
10 AM apply run, 3 PM sweep, 5 PM site check, 6 PM purge all run themselves.
Tomorrow: As I Lay Dying at Cornerstone, ~7:30 PM Thursday.
Tony's and Family calendars are clear today and tomorrow.
